message: Checking off a task now fills its box, crosses out the title and shows your streak going up before the row leaves, and unchecking plays it backwards. Switches, option rows and arrows now slide or turn rather than jump, counts roll to their new number, the Undo bar shows how long it will stay, and recipe photos fade in. Vibration is more consistent too: one buzz per action, settings switches buzz, swipes buzz when letting go would act, and a timer buzzes when it runs out. With Reduce Motion on, these fade instead of moving.
